content.short: MetaSleuth is a crypto tracking platform for DYOR, stolen funds recovery, compliance, and forensic analysis.
content.description: MetaSleuth is a comprehensive platform designed to help users monitor and investigate crypto activity across multiple networks. It lets you track funds, visualize fund flows, and monitor real-time movements, while securely saving key details and collaborating by sharing findings with others. The tool supports 13 blockchains, including Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Fantom, Arbitrum, Cronos, Moonbeam, Avalanche, OP Mainnet, Solana, Polygon zkEVM, Multichain, and Aptos.
content.meta: MetaSleuth is a platform to track and investigate crypto activities. Discover MetaSleuth and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
